_note: Floors, not targets. Set from measured performance and raised deliberately; never lowered to make a build pass. A drop means the sweep got worse and the corpus is telling you so.
_realNote: Floors that apply to real solicitations only. They are null until the corpus has real cases: setting them earlier would fail every build without measuring anything. Set `minimumRealCases` first, then `realRecall` from what the corpus actually achieves — never above it, and never lowered afterwards.
